media/sabbatical-travel/travel-07.jpeg.story: At a sanctuary on the shores of Lake Victoria, a chimpanzee peers through the fence with calm intensity. The sanctuary setting speaks to conservation efforts protecting these primates in Uganda.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-08.jpeg.caption: Llama Among Ruins
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-08.jpeg.alt: An alpaca stands on grassy terrain near stone walls of ancient ruins, with a person taking photos in the background against a backdrop of towering mountains.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-08.jpeg.story: A serene moment unfolds at ancient Incan ruins, where a llama grazes peacefully in the foreground while a lone tourist captures the majestic mountain backdrop. The juxtaposition of nature and history creates a tranquil yet awe-inspiring scene.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-09.jpeg.caption: Emperor Penguins in Harmony
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-09.jpeg.alt: Two emperor penguins standing side by side on a snowy landscape, their distinctive black and white feathers and yellow accents visible against the bright background. The scene captures the serene and cold environment typical of Antarctica.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-09.jpeg.story: Two emperor penguins stand close together in a serene, snow-covered environment, their striking black and white plumage contrasting sharply with the pristine whiteness of the ice. Their gaze suggests a moment of connection or communication, highlighting the resilience and beauty of these majestic birds in one of Earth's harshest environments.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-10.jpeg.caption: Solitude in the Rain
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-10.jpeg.alt: A koala is perched on a tree branch, wrapped snugly in its fur during a rainy day. The background is blurred with green foliage, emphasizing the animal's solitary presence.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-10.jpeg.story: A koala clings tightly to a tree branch, its small form huddled against the wet weather. The scene captures a moment of vulnerability and resilience in nature as rain falls gently around it.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-11.jpeg.caption: Amusement Park in Yerevan
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-11.jpeg.alt: A colorful cartoon-themed amusement park ride in the foreground with a large statue visible among trees under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds in Yerevan, Armenia.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-11.jpeg.story: A festive amusement park in Yerevan sits beneath open skies, its cartoon-themed rides and bright decorations contrasting with a stately statue rising from the trees behind.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-12.jpeg.caption: Eternal Glory: Acropolis at Night
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-12.jpeg.alt: A nighttime view of the Acropolis of Athens, featuring the Parthenon lit up on a hillside overlooking a sprawling cityscape with illuminated buildings. The dark sky enhances the glow of the ruins and modern structures below.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-12.jpeg.story: The ancient Acropolis of Athens stands majestically against the night sky, its iconic Parthenon glowing with warm light that contrasts sharply with the dark surroundings. The city below is a tapestry of illuminated streets and modern architecture, creating a striking juxtaposition between ancient history and contemporary urban life.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-13.jpeg.caption: Frozen Majesty: A Mountain's Silent Solitude
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-13.jpeg.alt: A towering snow-covered mountain surrounded by icebergs and glaciers, set against a cold, barren landscape. The scene captures the serene yet powerful beauty of an icy wilderness.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-13.jpeg.story: A majestic snow-capped mountain rises dramatically from a frozen, icy expanse. The rugged terrain and stark white peaks evoke a sense of isolation and the raw power of nature in one of Earth's most remote and pristine environments.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-14.jpeg.caption: Night Sky over Cajón del Maipo
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-14.jpeg.alt: Star-filled night sky above rugged Andean mountains with silhouetted trees in the foreground, photographed in Cajón del Maipo, Chile.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-14.jpeg.story: Under an impossibly clear Andean sky, the peaks of Cajón del Maipo recede into darkness while thousands of stars press close overhead. The photographer initially misidentified this as Argentina, but corrected to Chile — a reminder of how the border dissolves in terrain this vast.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-15.jpeg.caption: Lone Figure on Antarctic Ice
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-15.jpeg.alt: A person walks across a vast expanse of white Antarctic terrain, leaving a trail of footprints behind them.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-15.jpeg.story: A lone figure crosses the Antarctic ice, their footprints the only mark on an otherwise untouched white expanse. The scale of the landscape dwarfs the traveler, underscoring the profound isolation of the continent.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-16.jpeg.caption: Christmas Tree in Mammoth Cave
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-16.jpeg.alt: A black-and-white photograph of a brightly lit Christmas tree glowing inside Mammoth Cave, surrounded by rugged limestone rock formations in deep shadow.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-16.jpeg.story: A decorated Christmas tree stands illuminated against the ancient limestone walls of Mammoth Cave, its warm glow cutting through the darkness of one of the world's longest cave systems in Kentucky.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-17.jpeg.caption: Hummingbird at rest, Santiago
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-17.jpeg.alt: A hummingbird with brownish iridescent plumage perched on a thin, leafless branch against a blurred green forest backdrop, its long beak and small size clearly visible.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-17.jpeg.story: A hummingbird pauses on a bare branch in the forests near Santiago, its iridescent feathers catching the diffuse light of the Chilean hillside.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-18.jpeg.caption: Timeless Guardians: Temple Entrance at Abu Simbel
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-18.jpeg.alt: A grand ancient Egyptian temple entrance featuring large stone statues flanking an ornate doorway with hieroglyphics carved into the walls. A tourist stands near the entrance, emphasizing the scale and majesty of the structure.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-18.jpeg.story: The grandeur of ancient Egyptian architecture is captured in this scene, showcasing a temple entrance adorned with colossal statues and intricate hieroglyphics. The warm desert sunlight bathes the sandstone structures, highlighting their historical significance and inviting visitors to explore the rich cultural heritage.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-19.jpeg.caption: Neon Dreams: A Night in the City
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-19.jpeg.alt: A nighttime street scene packed with bright neon signs, colorful billboards, and hanging red lanterns. Wires and pipes crisscross overhead while raindrops glisten on every surface.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-19.jpeg.story: The vibrant streets of a bustling Japanese city come alive at night, illuminated by dazzling neon lights and traditional lanterns. Raindrops catch the electric glow as signs advertising local businesses jostle for space with red lanterns overhead.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-20.jpeg.caption: Cherry blossoms against Kyoto skyline
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-20.jpeg.alt: Close-up of pink and white cherry blossom petals on a bare branch, with blurred modern buildings in the background. The scene captures spring blooming in an urban Kyoto setting.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-20.jpeg.story: A cherry blossom branch catches the light against Kyoto's urban backdrop, the soft petals a reminder that spring arrives even amid the city's modern skyline.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-21.jpeg.caption: Otters surfacing in Tambopata
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-21.jpeg.alt: Three river otters swimming at the surface of calm water in Tambopata National Park, Peru, with one otter's face clearly visible looking toward the camera.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-21.jpeg.story: A family group of giant river otters surfaces in the still waters of Tambopata National Park, one turning its whiskered face toward the lens. The Peruvian Amazon's most charismatic residents move with an ease that belies their size.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-22.jpeg.caption: Gorilla Portrait, Volcanoes National Park
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-22.jpeg.alt: Close-up portrait of a mountain gorilla partially obscured by green leaves in a forest setting, its dark eyes gazing directly at the camera.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-22.jpeg.story: In Rwanda's Volcanoes National Park, a mountain gorilla peers through the dense forest foliage, its steady gaze offering a rare moment of connection between human and primate.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-23.jpeg.caption: Young Gorilla in Volcanoes National Park
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-23.jpeg.alt: A young mountain gorilla peers through dense green foliage in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-23.jpeg.story: A young mountain gorilla pauses amid the thick forest undergrowth of Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda. Its watchful eyes meet the camera through a curtain of leaves, offering a rare close encounter in one of the last wild habitats where these endangered primates survive.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-24.jpeg.caption: Harbor Reflections: Sydney's Iconic Beauty
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-24.jpeg.alt: The Sydney Opera House is captured from across the harbor, showcasing its distinctive white sails against a backdrop of water dotted with small waves. The foreground includes reflections on the wet docks and people walking along the pier, while sailboats are visible in the distance under a partly cloudy sky.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-24.jpeg.story: The iconic Sydney Opera House stands majestically by the harbor, its white sails reflecting off the rippling water. The scene is lively yet serene, with people strolling along the docks and sailboats dotting the horizon under a partly cloudy sky.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-25.jpeg.caption: Small bird perched among yellow blooms, Galápagos
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-25.jpeg.alt: A small dark bird rests on a branch surrounded by green leaves and yellow flowers in the Galápagos Islands, Ecuador.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-25.jpeg.story: A solitary bird perches among the flowering vegetation of the Galápagos Islands, its dark plumage set against delicate yellow blooms. The islands' unique flora frames the moment with quiet stillness.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-26.jpeg.caption: Silent Sentinels: Marine Iguanas of the Galápagos
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-26.jpeg.alt: A cluster of marine iguanas rests on a rocky beach, surrounded by volcanic terrain. One iguana is prominently featured with its mouth open, showcasing their distinctive behavior and environment.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-26.jpeg.story: A group of marine iguanas basks on a rocky beach, their rugged forms contrasting against the stark volcanic landscape. The central iguana stands out with its open mouth and alert posture, suggesting communication or thermoregulation in this unique Galápagos habitat.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-27.jpeg.caption: Golden Reflections on Salar de Uyuni
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-27.jpeg.alt: Bolivia's vast salt flat mirrors a sunset sky, golden light stretching across a perfectly still, flooded surface to a flat horizon.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-27.jpeg.story: During the wet season, Salar de Uyuni becomes the world's largest natural mirror, the boundary between sky and earth dissolving into a single plane of gold.

media/sabbatical-travel/travel-28.jpeg.caption: Reaching for the Sky: Burj Khalifa
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-28.jpeg.alt: The Burj Khalifa's distinctive spire rises against a clear blue sky, framed by a lush palm tree with curved architectural elements in the foreground.
media/sabbatical-travel/travel-28.jpeg.story: The Burj Khalifa pierces a vibrant blue sky, its sleek spire a testament to human engineering and ambition. A palm tree and surrounding architecture frame the shot, capturing Dubai's characteristic layering of natural and built form.
